supporting_observations.claim: Two network logon attempts for noah.kim failed with incorrect-password status from 198.51.100.201, at 13:42:55 and 13:44:17 UTC.
A network logon for noah.kim then succeeded at 13:45:40 UTC from the same IP address, 198.51.100.201.

The rapid sequence of wrong-password failures followed by a successful logon from the same source is consistent with unauthorized credential guessing or use of obtained credentials. The source is not an approved remote-administration workstation under the supplied environment context.

The failed events identify the workstation as 198.51.100.201, while the successful event identifies it as DC-MAP-01, despite reporting the same source IP. This leaves the source attribution inconsistent.

known_telemetry_limitations: Proxy logs were not collected from 13:25 to 14:20 UTC on 2026-09-22, overlapping the alerted activity.
The supplied records show the authentication events but do not include records identifying who controlled 198.51.100.201 or what was accessed after the successful logon.
claims_not_established: The evidence does not establish who initiated the attempts or whether the source IP was spoofed, misattributed, or controlled by an attacker.
The successful logon does not by itself establish what resources were accessed, whether data was viewed or changed, or whether the account was otherwise compromised.
The records do not establish whether the activity was authorized through an exception not represented in the supplied environment context.
additional_evidence_needed: Identify and validate the owner and location of 198.51.100.201 using network, DHCP, firewall, and endpoint records.
Review domain-controller and destination-host logs for the successful session, subsequent access, and related authentication activity.
Determine whether noah.kim recognizes or authorized the activity; review account changes, active sessions, and credential-use history.
Preserve relevant logs and, following incident-response procedures, consider revoking sessions and resetting noah.kim's credentials.
